answer: Put every claimant behind a cipher wall: peers get an encrypted bundle of the work plus a decoy bundle that was never submitted, and must rank which shows real provenance without being told which is which. Since the decoy comes from the same pipeline, guessing beats copying. A lantern then sweeps a rotating region each epoch, and only identities whose local record illuminates cleanly may collect there, so a cluster hiding its links stays dark. Each result is refracted through a prism: one claim must look consistent from three viewpoints, and inconsistency flags the bundle.
